headline: Quiet overnight: UnrealIRCd and Check Point KEV deadlines hit 11-16; SCKit still top story; Cursor extension breach

bullets.text: No new reports since the last briefing. KEV deadlines arrive 11-16 for two exploited flaws: UnrealIRCd CVE-2026-114713 (server-level command injection) and Check Point CVE-2026-123039.
Check Point PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-123039, 5 outlets): attackers gain root on gateways, plant a TSGA backdoor and deploy a VMware ESXi wiper.
SCKit remains the top story at 9 outlets: worm-like malware aimed at MSPs that abuses ScreenConnect to deploy remote access and target technician sessions. Microsoft has published details.
Cursor confirms a security breach led to a malicious Claude Code extension (BleepingComputer). The board carries no further detail on affected versions or a clean release yet.

Trezor confirms crypto-stealing implants in three wallets sold via CryptoBilis and has released a fix. Breaches also on the board: Uber driver licenses via Fireworks AI, City of Osaka (1 million), TSMC, Norwegian/Widerøe, UT Arlington.

Still active: Apache httpd CVE-2026-119618 and the SignDrop Windows SYSTEM zero-day. KEV due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Openwave CVE-2026-111793, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. Last 7 days run 1.15x the 90-day average.

actions: UnrealIRCd: patch or take internet-facing servers offline for CVE-2026-114713 before the 11-16 KEV due date, and check them for injected commands.
Check Point: apply the vendor fix for CVE-2026-123039 before 11-16, restrict management access, hunt for TSGA backdoors, keep ESXi backups offline.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions, review technician sessions and hunt for SCKit using Microsoft's guidance.
Cursor and Claude Code users: review installed extensions against Cursor's disclosure and remove any you cannot verify.
Trezor owners who bought via CryptoBilis: follow Trezor's advisory and apply its fix; move funds if the recovery phrase may be exposed.
Patch Apache httpd for CVE-2026-119618 and queue BroadWorks, Openwave, Outlook and Chromium before 11-24.
